required_before_genuine_org_claim: Use an approved disposable scratch org or sandbox and freeze API version, permissions, sharing, automation, packages, and source identity.
Run allow and denial cases under a deliberately low-privilege user configuration and assert either the expected user-mode failure or stripInaccessible outcome with no protected side effect.
Run real Apex tests at 1 and 200 records, assert business output and Limits.getQueries()/Limits.getDmlStatements() deltas against a declared budget.
Install only declared project dependencies in an isolated checkout, run actual LWC Jest tests, then verify the user-visible flow in a browser/org.
Retain command output, test classes, source hash, permission/data fixture description, API version, and limits deltas as the evidence receipt.
